app.catalogError: Your product list could not be opened.
app.modelError: The recognition model could not be loaded.

camera.why: BantayNiMama recognises your products with the camera. The photos stay on this phone and are never sent anywhere.
camera.askAgain: Scanning needs the camera. Tap Allow camera, then allow it.
camera.blocked: The camera is turned off for BantayNiMama. Open Settings, go to Permissions, and allow Camera. Then come back to the app.
camera.none: No back camera was found on this phone.

welcome.title: Welcome to BantayNiMama
welcome.body: Point the camera at an item to see its price. First, add your first 5 items. Each one takes about 30 seconds.

enroll.title: Add a product
enroll.name: Product name
enroll.namePlaceholder: e.g. Lucky Me Pancit Canton Kalamansi
enroll.pricePack: Price for the whole pack (₱, optional)

repacked.label: Looks like other items (repacked)
repacked.hint: For clear bags of sugar, salt or rice. The scanner will ask which one instead of naming it.

guided.savedTry: Saved: {{name}}. Now try scanning it: hold it inside the box.
guided.complete: All {{target}} added. You can add more items any time.

enroll.coach: Just one item inside the box.

more.show: More details: pack price, unit, category

angle.turnLeft: Photo {{n}}: turn it a little to the left
angle.turnRight: Photo {{n}}: turn it a little to the right
angle.backOrTop: Photo {{n}}: the back or the top
angle.otherLight: Photo {{n}}: move it to different light

quality.tooDark: Photo {{n}} looks too dark. Tap it to remove it, then retake it with more light.
quality.blownOut: Photo {{n}} looks too bright. Tap it to remove it, then retake it away from the glare.
quality.blurred: Photo {{n}} looks blurry. Tap it to remove it, then hold still and retake it.

errors.piecePriceInvalid: The price per piece should look like 12.50.
errors.packPriceInvalid: The pack price should look like 120.00.
errors.modelNotReady: The camera model is still loading. Try again in a moment.
errors.saveFailed: The product was not saved, and its photos were removed. Please take the photos again. ({{message}})

duplicate.live: Looks like something already in your list: {{names}}
duplicate.title: Already in your list?
duplicate.body: These photos look like {{names}}. Save it as a new product anyway?
duplicate.markBothHint: Only if they look the same in a clear bag. Not for two sizes of one product.

scan.scanning: Point the box at a product
scan.frameError: The camera could not read a frame. ({{message}})

edit.title: Price of {{name}}
edit.hint: This changes {{name}} only, wherever the camera points now.
edit.gone: This product is no longer in your list.

undo.rebuildFailed: The scanner could not reload your list. Restart the app before scanning. ({{message}})

confirm.question: Is this {{name}}?
confirm.whySmall: While your list is small, the app asks before it shows a price.

quickPick.title: Looks like a repacked item. Which one?

reject.title: Not this one?
reject.correctHint: Keep the item inside the box, then tap the right product. The app learns from this photo.
reject.notInListHint: If this item is not in your list, keep it inside the box and tap below. The app will stop naming it.
reject.capturing: Keep the item still inside the box…
reject.saved: Saved. Next time, this item reads as Unknown.
reject.mismatch: The camera moved to something else, so nothing was saved. Keep the item inside the box and try again.

products.title: Products
products.empty: No products yet. Add one from the Scan tab.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.gone: This product is no longer in your list.
edit.deleteBody: It moves to Deleted products, where you can restore it for 30 days.
edit.deleteFailed: Deleted, but the scanner could not reload your list. Restart the app before scanning. ({{message}})

trash.title: Deleted products ({{n}})
trash.restoreFailed: Restored, but the scanner could not reload your list. Restart the app before scanning. ({{message}})

negatives.title: Not in my list ({{n}})
negatives.hint: Items you marked Not in my list. The app never names them. Delete one if it really is in your list.

source.wrong_chip: Marked after Wrong? on two choices

negatives.deleteBody: The app may name it again if it looks like one of your products.
negatives.failed: Deleted, but the scanner could not reload your list. Restart the app before scanning. ({{message}})

teach.title: Teach again: {{name}}
teach.hint: Hold {{name}} inside the box, from an angle or in light its photos do not show yet.
teach.counts: Photos: {{enroll}} reference, {{extra}} of {{max}} extra. When full, a new photo replaces the oldest extra.
teach.review: Is this {{name}}? Save only a photo of this product.
teach.saved: Saved. The app learned this view of {{name}}.
teach.gone: This product is no longer in your list.

quality.tooDark: This photo looks too dark. Retake it with more light.
quality.blownOut: This photo looks too bright. Retake it away from the glare.
quality.blurred: This photo looks blurry. Hold still and retake it.

gate.title: Gate check (debug)
gate.needsModel: The recognition model is still loading.
